default.title: Open-weight licences differ widely
default.content: Open-weight model licences range from permissive terms to ones that restrict commercial use above a user threshold.

default.title: Permissive licences dominate small models
default.content: Among models under 10 billion parameters, 70 percent are released under permissive licences such as Apache 2.0.

default.title: Use restrictions in responsible-AI licences
default.content: Responsible-AI licences attach use restrictions, such as bans on surveillance, that must be passed on to downstream users.

default.title: Open source definition debate
default.content: The Open Source Initiative published a definition of open-source AI that requires access to training-data information, which many open-weight releases do not meet.

default.title: Compliance costs for companies
default.content: Legal teams report spending several weeks per model on licence review when a licence has custom use restrictions.
